ns0:g.ns0:text: Rust or C++ for the backend of a native compiler?
Both work. Rust brings memory safety and enums for IR
passes; C++ has mature LLVM tooling. Choose by team skills
How do I read a file asynchronously in C#?
Use the async File API and await it inside an async
The Rust borrow checker rejects my loop. Why?
You are probably moving the collection. Iterate by
reference, and clone only what you must:
unique_ptr or a raw pointer in modern C++?
Default to std::unique_ptr for ownership. Keep raw
